issues.problem: bad[1].why claimed the idiom cannot describe focus on one's own studies, which overstates it (全心全意地学习/投入工作 is normal).
issues.action: Rewrote the reason to the real defect: it is an adverbial and cannot stand alone as a verb followed by a length of time.

issues.problem: ctx[1] (看得泪流满面) and ctx[3] (抱在一起，泪流满面) could equally take the in-set near-synonym 热泪盈眶.
issues.action: Rewrote both with 哭得 and streaming detail so only tears running down the face fits.

issues.problem: ctx[1] (等成绩时一直坐立不安) fits the in-set near-synonym 忐忑不安 just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it to show physical restlessness (pacing around the room).

issues.problem: bad[0] (sunburn, 晒得面红耳赤) is borderline rather than clearly wrong, since the idiom also covers flushing from heat and strain.
issues.action: Replaced it with a clearly wrong use: describing a red apple.

issues.problem: All stories are null; none of these descriptive idioms has a well-known origin story.
